Overview

San Pedro de Macorís is a city in 23 with a population of 220,000. A port city known as the birthplace of many Dominican baseball stars and its sugar industry heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
